title: The social cost: unemployment, informal work and hyperinflation
goal: Read how the crisis and the cuts hit jobs, wages, health and education, using cuanto más and a medida que.
grammar: proportional constructions: cuanto más ... más, a medida que

items: I can explain how unemployment, informal work and falling wages affected families.
I can say what cuts in subsidies and public spending meant for the poor.
I can name the countries and years of the hyperinflations.
I can link two changes that grow together with *cuanto más … más …* and *a medida que*.
